p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 17 x 34 cm Sweepex sponge float is the big hand float for washing grout off floors. Sweepex is Raimondi's very high absorption sponge, so each pass lifts more grout water than a standard sponge, and the large face covers a floor quickly. The sponge clips off the Easy Lock handle in seconds when it wears, so you only replace the sponge.

Use it for

  • Washing cement grout residue off floor and wall tiles
  • Working with the Pedalo wash bucket, which this float comes with

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge
  • Quick change Easy Lock interchangeable sponge
  • Ergonomic handle

Specifications

  • Sponge: 17 x 34 x 4 cm
  • Model: 336 SWE
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • Supplied with the Pedalo; takes the 17 x 34 cm Sweepex spare sponges (plain Art. 336 RICSWE, with cuts, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • The version with cuts flexes into textured tiles and wide joints; the carved sponge suits structured surfaces.
  • Rinse and wring well between passes so you lift grout rather than spread it.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 17 x 34 cm Sweepex float with cut sponge is the big hand float for washing grout off textured tiles. The cuts across the sponge let it flex down into structured surfaces and wide joints that a flat sponge skates over, while the very high absorption Sweepex lifts the grout water away. The sponge clips off the Easy Lock handle when it wears.

Use it for

  • Washing cement grout residue off textured, stone look and timber look tiles
  • Floors with wide joints

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge with cuts
  • Quick change Easy Lock interchangeable sponge
  • Ergonomic handle

Specifications

  • Sponge: 17 x 34 x 4 cm
  • Model: 336 SWET
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • Pedalo and other 17 x 34 cm Raimondi floats; takes the 17 x 34 cm Sweepex spare sponges (with cuts Art. 336 RICSWET, plain, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • For smooth tiles the plain Sweepex float holds a little more water.
  • Rinse and wring well between passes so you lift grout rather than spread it.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Replacement Sweepex sponge for the Raimondi 17 x 34 cm quick change float. The sponge is the only part of the float that wears, and a fresh Sweepex sponge brings back the very high absorption that lets you wash a floor in fewer passes. It clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds, no tools.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 17 x 34 cm floats, including the one supplied with the Pedalo

Specifications

  • Size: 17 x 34 x 4 cm
  • Sweepex sponge, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 336 RICSWE
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Change the sponge when it goes hard, tears at the corners or stops holding water.
  • The same size is made with cuts and carved for textured tiles, and in cellulose for epoxy grout.
  • Rinse the sponge clean and let it dry between jobs so grout does not set in it.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Replacement Sweepex sponge with cuts for the Raimondi 17 x 34 cm quick change float. The cuts let the sponge flex down into textured tiles and wide joints, so it washes grout off structured surfaces that a flat sponge glides over, and the Sweepex material keeps the very high absorption. It clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 17 x 34 cm floats, including the one supplied with the Pedalo

Specifications

  • Size: 17 x 34 x 4 cm
  • Sweepex sponge with cuts, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 336 RICSWET
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Use it on stone look, timber look and other textured porcelain. For smooth tiles the plain sponge holds a little more water.
  • For epoxy grout Raimondi makes a cellulose sponge in the same size.
  • Rinse clean and dry between jobs so grout does not set in the cuts.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Carved replacement Sweepex sponge for the Raimondi 17 x 34 cm quick change float. The carved face is Raimondi's deepest profile, made to follow heavily structured and relief tiles so the sponge reaches the grout in the low spots instead of only wiping the high points. It clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 17 x 34 cm floats, including the one supplied with the Pedalo

Specifications

  • Size: 17 x 34 x 4 cm
  • Carved Sweepex sponge, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 336 RICSWESCO
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Raimondi makes the same size in plain Sweepex for smooth tiles, Sweepex with cuts for lightly textured tiles, and cellulose for epoxy grout.
  • Wring the carved sponge well. It holds water in the grooves and can drip across clean tile.
  • Rinse clean and dry between jobs.

p5.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 13 x 42 cm Sweepex pole float lets you wash grout off a floor standing up. The plate takes a 27 mm aluminium handle, and with the Pedalo bucket's foot pedal doing the squeezing you clean a whole floor without kneeling. The very high absorption Sweepex sponge lifts plenty of grout water each pass, and it clips off the plate for replacement. Supplied without handle.

Use it for

  • Stand up grout clean-up on floors with the Pedalo system
  • Washing down large floors after grouting

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge
  • Quick change interchangeable sponge
  • Plate fits Raimondi 27 mm aluminium handles

Specifications

  • Sponge: 13 x 42 x 3 cm
  • Model: 355FSSWOH
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • Pedalo stand up system on the Raimondi 27 mm aluminium handle (133 cm, sectional or 178 cm)
  • Takes the 13 x 42 cm Sweepex spare sponges (plain, with cuts, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • This is the float supplied with the Pedalo, so it is the replacement if yours is worn or lost.
  • Rinse and wring between passes so you lift grout rather than spread it.

p6.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 13 x 42 cm Sweepex pole float with cut sponge is the stand up float for washing grout off textured floors. The cuts let the sponge flex into structured tiles and wide joints that a flat sponge glides over, and the plate takes a 27 mm aluminium handle so you work upright with the Pedalo bucket. Supplied without handle.

Use it for

  • Stand up grout clean-up on textured, stone look and timber look floor tiles
  • Floors with wide joints

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge with cuts
  • Quick change interchangeable sponge
  • Plate fits Raimondi 27 mm aluminium handles

Specifications

  • Sponge: 13 x 42 x 3 cm
  • Model: 355FSSWOHT
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • Pedalo stand up system on the Raimondi 27 mm aluminium handle (133 cm, sectional or 178 cm)
  • Takes the 13 x 42 cm Sweepex spare sponges (with cuts, plain, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • For smooth tiles the plain Sweepex pole float holds a little more water.
  • Rinse and wring between passes so you lift grout rather than spread it.

p7.descriptionHtml:
Carved replacement Sweepex sponge for the Raimondi 13 x 42 cm pole float. The carved face is Raimondi's deepest sponge profile, cut to follow heavily structured and relief tiles so it reaches the grout in the low spots, and the Sweepex material keeps the very high absorption. It clips onto the pole float plate so you keep washing floors standing up with the Pedalo.

Fits

  • Raimondi 13 x 42 cm pole float (supplied with the Pedalo) on the sectional aluminium handle

Specifications

  • Size: 13 x 42 x 3 cm
  • Carved Sweepex sponge, very high absorption
  • Quick change fitting
  • Model: 355RICSWESCO
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Raimondi makes the same size in plain Sweepex for smooth tiles, Sweepex with cuts for lightly textured tiles, and cellulose for epoxy grout.
  • Wring the carved sponge well in the Pedalo rollers. It holds water in the grooves.
  • Rinse clean and dry between jobs so grout does not set in the carving.
